declaration.intent: Define the authority, immutability, conventions, and scope of the Forge Stack. All stack documents inherit this capsule; no stack document may override its terms.

terminology_authority.rule: The glossary defines all stack terms. A glossary revision is a new capsule identity and requires a new governance capsule version pinning it.

constraints.immutability: Documents are never edited in place. A revision is a new capsule identity (-vN suffix bump) inheriting from its predecessor. Every document hash lands in the ledger.
constraints.licence_default: Lite scs may omit licence; they inherit MSL-1.0 from this root. Full capsules must declare licence explicitly or cite this root.

conventions.capitalisation: All-caps names are acronyms with stated expansion. Ordinary words are lowercase unless proper nouns.
conventions.system_artefact_symmetry: SCP→sc, DataCube→cube, ChronoSCRIBE→ledger, HAL→seal; Leighton Weight's output is λ.

constraints.scope_principle: The glossary defines the stack, not the builds. Projects built on the stack are consumers; their internal terminology lives in their own repositories.
constraints.persona: Consumer-level only. The root capsule explicitly does not define a stack-wide persona.
constraints.multi_agent: Spine-level. The Spine governs stage interaction and agent coordination; not root-level.
